stock: SELECT * FROM sale_stock ORDER BY name
move: WHERE id=@lot AND typeof(@qty) IN ('integer','real') AND abs(@qty) BETWEEN 0.000001 AND 1000000
AND (@target IS NULL AND stock+@qty>=0 OR @target IS NOT NULL AND @target!=warehouse AND @qty>0
AND (unit NOT IN ('шт','уп') OR abs(@qty*factor-round(@qty*factor))<0.0000001 OR contentUnit
NOT IN ('шт','уп') AND contentUnit IS NOT NULL)
history: SELECT 'sale:'||l.rowid id,'Продажа' operation,CAST(strftime('%s',s.date) AS INTEGER)*1000 postedAt,s.warehouse
s.accountName AS accountName,s.seller AS employee,s.account AS accountId,
CASE WHEN json_valid(l.lot) THEN json_extract(l.lot,'$[1]') END AS productId FROM
sale_lines l JOIN sales s ON s.id=l.sale
UNION ALL SELECT m.id,CASE WHEN r.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Ревизия' WHEN target IS NULL THEN 'Корректировка' ELSE 'Перемещение · расход'
END,m.created,source,w.name,m.name,CASE WHEN r.id IS NOT NULL THEN round(qty*coalesce(json_extract(lot,'$[4]'),1),6)
WHEN target IS NULL THEN qty ELSE -qty END,CASE WHEN r.id IS NOT NULL THEN coalesce(json_extract(lot,'$[3]'),
CASE WHEN json_valid(m.lot) THEN json_extract(m.lot,'$[1]') END
FROM stock_movements m JOIN warehouses w ON w.id=m.source LEFT JOIN stock_revisions r
CASE WHEN json_valid(m.lot) THEN json_extract(m.lot,'$[1]') END
FROM stock_movements m JOIN warehouses w ON w.id=m.target
canReduceReceiptStock: SELECT 1 FROM sale_stock s JOIN stock_receipts r ON r.id=@id
WHERE round(coalesce((SELECT b.quantity FROM stock_batches b WHERE b.lot=s.id AND b.receipt=r.id),
s.stock-coalesce((SELECT sum(b.quantity) FROM stock_batches b WHERE b.lot=s.id),0))-@reduction,9)>=0
